decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed two-storey, three-bedroom dwellinghouse, by reason of its size, bulk, and appearance, would represent an overbearing and un-neighbourly development, which would result in an undue loss of outlook to the neighbouring residential properties. The proposal would represent in an overdevelopment of the site and an unacceptable form of backland development, detrimental to the visual amenities and character of the area and the residential amenities of the adjoining properties, contrary to adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1, H.1.1, & H.3.3 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and policy ENVB.1.1, H.1.1 & H.6.3 of the Revised Deposit Version UDP (January 2001) and associated supplementary planning guidance.
description: ERECTION OF A DETACHED 3 BEDROOM DWELLINGHOUSE WITH ASSOCIATED PARKING AND LANDSCAPING
